detail.title: Dahua 4MP Smart ANPR Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite ITC436-PW9H KIT Dahua 4MP Smart ANPR Camera Key Points • 120+ countries license plate recognition with high accuracy ≥ 98% (EU) & 96% (others) • See better: 4MP, F1.6 mega-aperture with intelligent defogging technology ensures capture of over 99% of vehicles. • Safer & Secure: Instantly spot unauthorized vehicles and identify critical details like vehicle brand, color, license status. • Auto-Sync Parking Access: Unified I/O control for barriers & electric gates. • Deployment-Ready: The mounting pole is included in the package. Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Camera.Min. Illumination: 0.001 lux@F1.4 (Color, 30 IRE) 0.0002 lux@F1.4 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
Camera.Smart Illumination: According to the brightness of the environment, the camera automatically adjusts the intensity of its light to reveal the details of moving targets. Devices with warm light can automatically adjust the light intensity according to the time.
Camera.Image Tampering Prevention: Yes. Watermarks can be added to videos and images. The watermark can also be verified.
Camera.Network Protocol: HTTP; Https; 802.1x; TCP; ARP; RTSP; RTP; UDP; RTCP; SMTP; FTP; DHCP; DNS; IPv4/v6; NTP; SFTP; DDNS; SNMP; PPPoE
Camera.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S/Profile T/Profile M); CGI; ITSAPI; P2P
Camera.Security: Username and password; MAC address; HTTPS; IEEE 802.1x; network access control
Camera.Browser: Plug in: IE 9, 10, 11. Chrome 52 and earlier versions Firefox 42 and earlier versions No plug in: Chrome 92 and later versions
Camera.Image Setting: Brightness; contrast; saturation; gamma; sharpness; gain; white balance
Camera.Day/Night: IR filter, support three modes: color, B/W, auto
Camera.White Balance: Auto; Regional Custom; Manual; Outdoor; Natural; Street Lamp
Camera.OSD Overlay: Supports overlay of time; address (position of channel), lane (number/direction), plate (number and color), vehicle (color and type)
Camera.Storage: Built-in one TF card port; TF card (up to 256 GB)
Camera.Alarm Input: 3 channel, optocoupler input (wet node on-off value: 5 V)
Camera.Alarm Output: 2 channel, relay output (2 A, 30 VDC/0.5 A, 125 VAC), which can connect to devices such as barriers
Camera.Basic Event: Alarms for events of no storage card, storage card no space, storage card error, network disconnection, IP conflict, and illegal access.
Camera.Alarm Linkage: Upload to FTP/Memory card, notify monitoring center, send e-mail, trigger alert output.
Camera.AI Recognition: Recognizes vehicle types, vehicle signs, vehicle color, vehicle plate, vehicle without plate.
Camera.Video Metadata: Displays the intelligent frame, plate and vehicle paths.
Camera.Vehicle Color: Recognizes 12 colors: Grey, black, white, silver, blue, green, purple, red, orange, pink, brown, and yellow.
Camera.Vehicle Type Recognition: Recognizes 10 vehicle types: Large Bus, Heavy Truck, Medium Truck, Sedan, Van, Light Truck, Medium Bus, SUV, MPV, Pickup
Camera.Country and Region Supported by ANPR: Baseline support: 10 options (87 countries) General: Supports universal characters GCC (U.A.E., Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Oman, Iraq, Egypt, Jordan, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Lebanon) South Africa: South Africa, Tanzania, Mozambique, Zambia, Uganda, Equatorial Guinea, Mauritius, Kenya South Asia Region (India Region) : India, Maldives Europe (Netherlands, France, Germany, Britain, Italy, Poland, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Slovakia, Spain, Denmark, Turkey, Israel, Czech Republic, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Switzerland, Austria, Hungary, Romania, Lithuania, Latvia, Sweden, Estonia, Portugal, Greece, Slovenia, Luxembourg, Palestine, Lebanon, Ireland, Finland, Norway, Croatia, North Macedonia) South American Economies Collection (Uruguay, Paraguay, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, Guyana, Bolivia ) Mexico and other countries: Mexico, Costa Rica, Curacao, Guatemala Eurasian Collection (Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Moldova, Lithuania, Latvia, Georgia, Azerbaijan, Turkmenistan) North America (United States, Canada) North Africa Region Collection: Tunisia, Morocco, Algeria, Libya The baseline algorithm is supported for the following 19 countries: Republic of Korea, Indonesia, Singapore, Cambodia, Australia, Thailand, Bassett, Nigeria, Pakistan, Viet Nam, Mongolia, Bangladesh, Myanmar, Philippines, Laos, Iraq, Japan, Maldives, Nepal.
Camera.Capture Rate: In the recommended installation and lighting condition, the vehicle capture rate ≥ 99%
Camera.Recognition Rate: In the recommended installation and lighting condition, the recognition rate for positive and departing vehicles≥ 96%; the recognition rate for European vehicle plates ≥ 98%
Camera.Power Consumption: Power consumption in different conditions: No lighting < 10 W Lighting <20 W
